title.en: The HIMS weekend float squeeze, replayed on-chain
title.zh: HIMS 週末流通量擠壓：鏈上重播

dek.en: Over the last weekend of August 2026, a memecoin quoted in tokenized HIMS soaked up most of the stock token's frozen weekend supply, and the dollar pool briefly priced HIMS at more than twice its Friday close. Once the issuer could mint again on Monday the premium was gone in about 75 minutes, and this page replays those hours from Robinhood Chain's own logs.
dek.zh: 2026 年 8 月最後一個週末，一個以代幣化 HIMS 計價的迷因幣吸走了這檔股票代幣週末被凍結的大部分流通量，美元池裡的 HIMS 報價一度超過週五收盤價的兩倍。週一發行方恢復鑄造後，溢價在約 75 分鐘內消失；本頁用 Robinhood Chain 自己的鏈上紀錄重播這幾個小時。

tldr.en: Robinhood's HIMS stock token can only be minted or redeemed while the brokerage side is trading, so over the weekend its on-chain supply was frozen at about 15,227 tokens.
tldr.zh: Robinhood 的 HIMS 股票代幣只有在券商那一端開盤時才能鑄造或贖回，所以整個週末鏈上流通量被凍結在約 15,227 顆。

tldr.en: The memecoin BONER is quoted in HIMS, so buying it with dollars meant buying HIMS first. On Sunday night the dollar pool's HIMS fell from about 2,606 at 19:40 to under 4 at 23:25 UTC (about 67 by 23:53), while BONER's pool kept filling up.
tldr.zh: 迷因幣 BONER 以 HIMS 計價，用美元買它就得先買 HIMS。週日深夜，美元池裡的 HIMS 從 19:40 的約 2,606 顆，降到 23:25 UTC 不到 4 顆（23:53 約 67 顆），BONER 的池子則越裝越多。

tldr.en: Above the LPs' ranges there was almost nothing left to sell: pushing the price up 10% cost about 12 USDG instead of about 1,351 (3.85 at the low), and the pool's minute close reached 71.23 against a 28.84 close.
tldr.zh: LP 區間之上幾乎沒有 HIMS 可賣：把價格推高 10% 只要約 12 USDG，而不是約 1,351（最低時 3.85）；池子的分鐘收盤價最高到 71.23，而週五收盤價是 28.84。

tldr.en: Minting resumed at Mon 00:43 UTC and the price was back near NAV within about 75 minutes. BONER kept a gain of about 4x, the losses fell on whoever bought HIMS far above NAV, and the NYSE opened as if nothing had happened.
tldr.zh: 週一 00:43 UTC 恢復鑄造，約 75 分鐘內價格回到淨值附近。BONER 保住約 4 倍漲幅，虧損落在遠高於淨值買進 HIMS 的人身上，紐約證交所週一照常開盤，彷彿什麼事都沒發生。

title.en: A stock token behaving like a stock
title.zh: 一檔表現正常的股票代幣

summary.en: Two hours before the NYSE close, tokenized HIMS trades on-chain within about 2% of the price the stock closes at that evening.
summary.zh: 紐約證交所收盤前兩小時，鏈上的代幣化 HIMS 與當晚的收盤價只差約 2%。

en: **HIMS** here is Robinhood's token for Hims & Hers stock on Robinhood Chain. The issuer mints new tokens against shares it holds and burns them on redemption, so supply can follow demand, but only while the brokerage side is trading.

At Fri 19:40 UTC the main **HIMS/USDG** pool quoted about 28.17 USDG, against a NYSE close that evening of 28.84. About 16,127 HIMS existed on-chain, and roughly 12,700 of them were already sitting in Uniswap v4 pools.

The largest holder was a pool, not a person. **BONER**, a memecoin launched on 20 August, is quoted in HIMS rather than dollars, and its main pool alone held about 8,700 HIMS, more than half of the supply.
zh: 這裡的 **HIMS** 是 Robinhood 在 Robinhood Chain 上發行、對應 Hims & Hers 股票的代幣。發行方以持有的股票為擔保鑄造新代幣、在贖回時銷毀代幣，所以流通量可以跟著需求變動，但前提是券商那一端正在交易。
週五 19:40 UTC，主要的 **HIMS/USDG** 池報價約 28.17 USDG，當晚紐約證交所收盤價是 28.84。鏈上共有約 16,127 顆 HIMS，其中約 12,700 顆已經放在 Uniswap v4 的流動性池裡。
最大的持有者不是人，而是一個池子。**BONER** 是 8 月 20 日上線的迷因幣，用 HIMS 而不是美元計價，光是它的主池就握有約 8,700 顆 HIMS，超過流通量的一半。

presenterNote.en: Friday evening. HIMS is Robinhood's tokenized Hims & Hers share, trading on-chain around 28, right next to the NYSE price. One odd detail: a memecoin's pool already holds more HIMS than anyone.
presenterNote.zh: 週五晚上，HIMS 是 Robinhood 發行的 Hims & Hers 代幣化股票，鏈上約 28，和紐約收盤價幾乎一樣。注意一個怪地方：一個迷因幣的池子已經是最大的 HIMS 持有者。

title.en: The float shrinks into the weekend
title.zh: 進入週末前，流通量先縮水

summary.en: After the NYSE close, 900 HIMS are redeemed and the on-chain supply drops to about 15,227 tokens.
summary.zh: 紐約收盤後有 900 顆 HIMS 被贖回，鏈上流通量降到約 15,227 顆。

en: The NYSE closes at 20:00 UTC at **28.84**. Within the next 90 minutes a redemption wallet burns 500 and then 400 HIMS (20:37 and 21:21 UTC), cutting supply by about 5.6% to **15,226.8**.

A redemption is routine. What matters is what follows: once the 24/5 session closes for the weekend, nobody can create new HIMS until Sunday evening New York time. This is the float for the whole weekend.
zh: 紐約證交所 20:00 UTC 收盤，價格 **28.84**。接下來 90 分鐘內，一個贖回錢包先後銷毀 500 顆與 400 顆 HIMS（20:37 與 21:21 UTC），流通量少了約 5.6%，剩下 **15,226.8** 顆。
贖回本身很平常，關鍵在之後：24/5 交易時段週末收盤後，一直到紐約時間週日晚上，沒有人能再鑄造新的 HIMS。這就是整個週末的流通量。

presenterNote.en: Friday night the float actually shrinks: 900 tokens redeemed, about 15,227 left. That number is now frozen until Monday, because minting follows brokerage hours.
presenterNote.zh: 週五晚上流通量反而變少：900 顆被贖回，剩約 15,227 顆。這個數字會被凍結到週一，因為鑄造跟著券商的交易時間走。

title.en: The fence: supply closed, a quiet weekend
title.zh: 圍欄關上：供給凍結，週末很安靜

summary.en: With minting and redemption closed, the pools drift quietly: HIMS stays around 29–30 USDG while BONER slides.
summary.zh: 鑄造與贖回都關閉，池子平靜漂移：HIMS 維持在 29–30 USDG 附近，BONER 則一路下滑。

en: From Sat 00:00 UTC the mint/redeem window is closed (HAKARI's gauge models it as Sat 02:00 to Mon 02:00 Berlin time). Nobody can mint HIMS at NAV to sell into a high price, or redeem cheap tokens for shares. HAKARI calls a pool in this state **fenced**: the arbitrage that normally anchors its price cannot reach it.
For most of the weekend nothing happens. HIMS/USDG stays around 29–30 USDG, and BONER drifts down from about $0.0036 to about $0.0024.
At Sun 19:40 UTC the dollar pool's positions hold about **2,606 HIMS** and 69K USDG. Pushing the price up 10% and selling straight back would cost about **1,351 USDG** in fees. That is the baseline.
zh: 從週六 00:00 UTC 起，鑄造／贖回窗口關閉（HAKARI 的 gauge 以柏林時間週六 02:00 至週一 02:00 建模）。沒有人能按淨值鑄造 HIMS 去賣給高價，也沒有人能把便宜的代幣贖回成股票。HAKARI 把這種狀態的池子稱為**圍欄池**：平常把價格拉回原位的套利碰不到它。
週末大部分時間什麼事都沒發生。HIMS/USDG 維持在 29–30 USDG 附近，BONER 從約 $0.0036 慢慢跌到約 $0.0024。
週日 19:40 UTC，美元池的流動性部位約有 **2,606 顆 HIMS** 與 6.9 萬 USDG。把價格推高 10% 再立刻賣回，光手續費就要約 **1,351 USDG**。這是基準線。

presenterNote.en: Now the fence closes: no minting, no redemption until Monday. Saturday and most of Sunday are calm. Remember one number: pushing this pool 10% costs about 1,351 USDG.
presenterNote.zh: 圍欄關上了：週一之前不能鑄造也不能贖回。週六和週日大半天都很平靜。請記住一個數字：把這個池子推高 10% 要花約 1,351 USDG。

evidence.label: @0xSammy on Saturday: the same structure around tokenized NVDA

title.zh: 迷因幣的買盤繞道 HIMS

summary.en: BONER buying starts, and because BONER is priced in HIMS, every dollar-funded buy first takes HIMS out of the dollar pool.
summary.zh: BONER 的買盤出現；因為 BONER 以 HIMS 計價，每一筆用美元買 BONER 的交易都會先把 HIMS 從美元池拿走。

en: To buy BONER with dollars, the route is **USDG → HIMS → BONER**: buy HIMS in the HIMS/USDG pool, then swap it into the BONER pool. Memecoin demand becomes demand for a stock token whose supply is frozen. BONER also trades directly against USDG in a smaller pool (DeFiPrime puts it at about $160K); the route-gap lane shows how far the two BONER prices drift apart.

The HIMS that lands in the BONER/HIMS pool only comes back out when someone sells BONER. No LP withdrew from that pool all weekend, and its hook even adds liquidity inside users' trades, so while BONER buyers outnumber sellers, HIMS leaves the dollar pool far faster than it returns.
HIMS/USDG goes from about 29.73 at 21:46 to 36.22 at 22:28 and 39.94 at 23:02 UTC: about 38% over Friday's close, on a Sunday night with the stock market shut.
zh: 想用美元買 BONER，路由是 **USDG → HIMS → BONER**：先在 HIMS/USDG 池買 HIMS，再換進 BONER 池。迷因幣的需求就這樣變成對一檔供給被凍結的股票代幣的需求。BONER 另有一個直接對 USDG 的較小池子（DeFiPrime 估計約 16 萬美元），「路由價差」那條線顯示兩種 BONER 價格拉開多遠。
進了 BONER/HIMS 池的 HIMS，只有在有人賣出 BONER 時才會流出。整個週末沒有任何 LP 從這個池撤出流動性，它的 hook 甚至會在使用者的交易裡順手加入流動性，所以只要 BONER 的買盤多於賣盤，HIMS 離開美元池的速度就遠比回來快。
HIMS/USDG 從 21:46 的約 29.73，漲到 22:28 的 36.22、23:02 UTC 的 39.94：在股市休市的週日深夜，比週五收盤高了約 38%。

presenterNote.en: Sunday night the BONER buyers arrive. BONER is priced in HIMS, so every dollar buy pulls HIMS out of the dollar pool and parks it in the memecoin's pool. HIMS starts climbing.
presenterNote.zh: 週日深夜 BONER 的買家進場。BONER 用 HIMS 計價，每筆美元買單都把 HIMS 從美元池拉走、存進迷因幣的池子，HIMS 價格開始往上爬。

title.en: The dollar pool runs out of HIMS
title.zh: 美元池裡的 HIMS 快被搬空

summary.en: At 23:24:59 UTC one swap buys the last HIMS in the dollar pool's ranges; the minute close peaks at 71.23 USDG (+147%) at 23:31, DeFiPrime samples 61.15 at 23:36, and by 23:53 the positions hold only about 67 HIMS.
summary.zh: 23:24:59 UTC，一筆交易買走美元池區間內最後的 HIMS；分鐘收盤價在 23:31 衝到 71.23 USDG（+147%），DeFiPrime 在 23:36 取樣到 61.15，到 23:53 池中部位只剩約 67 顆 HIMS。

en: The rebuilt tape goes further than the published samples. At 23:24:59 UTC one swap bought the last 12.91 HIMS inside the LPs' ranges for 937.09 USDG, leaving the positions with **3.68 HIMS** against about 134,600 USDG; the minute close peaked at **71.23** (+147%) at 23:31, and single trades printed as high as 124.70 with almost no liquidity in range. DeFiPrime sampled **61.15** at 23:36:14 UTC, a 112% premium. By 23:53 the price was back at about 43.27, still 50% over, and the dollar pool's positions held only about **67 HIMS** against about 130K USDG. Shortly after midnight @0xSammy counted about 92 HIMS against about $135K.

LP flight explains only a small part of the thinning. Rebuilding every position between 19:40 and the first mint attributes about **91%** of the drop in the pool's HIMS to the price moving above the LPs' concentrated ranges and about **9%** to position changes (190 removals against 327 additions). Above those ranges there is very little HIMS left to sell.

The result: pushing the price another 10% and selling back now cost about **12 USDG** instead of 1,351, and 3.85 USDG at 23:25, when the pool had run dry. More than 80% of all HIMS in existence sat in BONER's pool, and BONER, measured in HIMS, had nearly tripled since 19:40.
zh: 重建的鏈上紀錄比公開取樣看到的更極端。23:24:59 UTC，一筆交易以 937.09 USDG 買走 LP 區間內最後的 12.91 顆 HIMS，部位只剩 **3.68 顆 HIMS**，對上約 13.46 萬 USDG；分鐘收盤價在 23:31 衝到 **71.23**（+147%），單筆成交最高印到 124.70，當下區間內幾乎沒有流動性。DeFiPrime 在 23:36:14 UTC 取樣到 **61.15**，溢價 112%。到 23:53 價格回到約 43.27，仍高出 50%，而美元池的部位只剩約 **67 顆 HIMS**，對上約 13 萬 USDG。午夜過後不久，@0xSammy 數到的是約 92 顆 HIMS 對約 13.5 萬美元。
LP 撤離只能解釋一小部分的變薄。重建 19:40 到首次鑄造前的每一個部位後，美元池 HIMS 的減少約 **91%** 可歸於價格漲出 LP 的集中流動性區間，約 **9%** 歸於部位變動（190 次撤出、327 次加入）。區間之上幾乎沒有 HIMS 可賣。
結果：把價格再推高 10% 然後賣回，成本只要約 **12 USDG**，而不是 1,351；23:25 池子被買空時更只要 3.85 USDG。此時全部 HIMS 有八成以上在 BONER 的池子裡；以 HIMS 計價的 BONER 從 19:40 起已漲了將近三倍。

presenterNote.en: The peak: above 71 for a stock that closed at 28.84. At 23:25 the dollar pool is down to under 4 HIMS; a 10% push costs a few USDG, about 12 by 23:53, not 1,351.
presenterNote.zh: 這是高峰：收盤 28.84 的股票，鏈上分鐘收盤超過 71。23:25 美元池只剩不到 4 顆 HIMS，把價格推 10% 只要幾 USDG，到 23:53 也只要約 12，而不是 1,351。

evidence.label: DeFiPrime: price progression and float table
HAKARI HIMS replay: cost to push +10% at 19:40 and 23:53

title.en: The market reopens, the mint does not, yet
title.zh: 市場重開，鑄造卻還沒來

summary.en: Robinhood's 24/5 session reopens at 00:00 UTC, but the first new HIMS lands only 43 minutes later, and the price spikes a second time.
summary.zh: Robinhood 的 24/5 時段在 00:00 UTC 重開，但第一批新的 HIMS 43 分鐘後才上鏈，價格又衝了一次。

en: At Mon 00:00 UTC (Sunday 20:00 in New York) Robinhood's 24/5 session reopens and the issuer can buy shares again. For 43 minutes, though, no mint reaches the chain. The price eases to about 34.33 at 00:13, then climbs back above **59** at 00:37 (+105%) and is still at about 54.50 when the first mint lands at 00:43.
The float is still frozen, so pushing the price 10% still costs only about 13 USDG. People were watching live: at 00:13 UTC @0xSammy posted that BONER's pool held about 81% of all on-chain HIMS.

The replies split. One warned that anyone buying at these levels would lose once arbitrage came back. At 00:42, a minute before the first mint, another argued the gap would vanish as soon as whoever holds mint rights minted and sold; @0xSammy questioned whether Robinhood's tokenization works that way.
zh: 週一 00:00 UTC（紐約週日 20:00），Robinhood 的 24/5 時段重開，發行方可以再買股票。但接下來 43 分鐘，鏈上沒有任何鑄造。價格在 00:13 回落到約 34.33，00:37 又衝上 **59** 以上（+105%），00:43 首次鑄造上鏈時仍在約 54.50。
流通量依然凍結，把價格推高 10% 仍然只要約 13 USDG。當時就有人即時關注：00:13 UTC @0xSammy 發文指出，BONER 的池子握有鏈上約 81% 的 HIMS。
回覆意見分歧。有人提醒，套利一回來，在這個價位買進的人會虧很多。00:42，也就是首次鑄造前一分鐘，另一則回覆認為只要有鑄造權的一方鑄造並賣出，價差就會消失；@0xSammy 則質疑 Robinhood 的代幣化機制是否真的這樣運作。

presenterNote.en: Midnight UTC the brokerage session reopens, but minting lags by 43 minutes. The float is still frozen, so the price spikes again, to about 59.
presenterNote.zh: UTC 午夜，券商的交易時段重開，但鑄造晚了 43 分鐘。流通量還是凍結的，所以價格又衝到約 59。

evidence.label: @0xSammy, Mon 00:13 UTC: BONER's pool holds ~81% of on-chain HIMS
@gmoneyNFT reply: late buyers lose once arbitrage returns
@0xSammy reply: calls it a test of Robinhood's token plumbing
@anondeguerre reply, Mon 00:42 UTC: the gap closes when the minter mints and sells
@0xSammy reply, Mon 00:46 UTC: questions that reading

title.en: The first mint, and the premium collapses

summary.en: At 00:43:30 UTC the issuer mints 1,000 HIMS; the premium peaks near 93% at 00:47, is down to about 12% by 00:55, and by 01:59 the price is back near NAV.
summary.zh: 00:43:30 UTC 發行方鑄造 1,000 顆 HIMS；溢價在 00:47 衝到約 93%，00:55 已掉到約 12%，01:59 價格回到淨值附近。

en: The first new supply since Friday: **1,000 HIMS** minted at 00:43:30 UTC, more than 51 hours after the last Friday burn. It is the first of **294 mints** that add about **18,750 HIMS** by 09:54, more than the entire weekend float.

New tokens go to the issuer's distribution wallet, and a market-making wallet sells them into the pools as they arrive (DeFiPrime notes it held under 25 HIMS by the end of the morning). The price goes from about 55.61 at 00:47 to 32.37 at 00:55 and 29.31 at 01:59.

Outside arbitrage was small change. Seconds after the first mint, two cyclic trades (USDG → HIMS → BONER → AI → USDG) cleared about 2.71 and 5.61 USDG before costs. What actually closed the gap was new supply, and only the issuer can mint.
zh: 週五之後第一批新供給：00:43:30 UTC 鑄造 **1,000 顆 HIMS**，距離週五最後一次銷毀已超過 51 小時。這是 **294 次鑄造**中的第一次，到 09:54 共增加約 **18,750 顆 HIMS**，比整個週末的流通量還多。
新代幣先進到發行方的分發錢包，再由一個造市錢包隨到隨賣進池子（DeFiPrime 指出它到早上結束時只剩不到 25 顆）。價格從 00:47 的約 55.61，掉到 00:55 的 32.37，01:59 回到 29.31。
外部套利只是零頭：首次鑄造後幾秒，兩筆循環交易（USDG → HIMS → BONER → AI → USDG）扣除成本前分別約賺 2.71 與 5.61 USDG。真正把價差收掉的是新供給，而只有發行方能鑄造。

presenterNote.en: First mint, 43 minutes after the reopen. The issuer sells new tokens into the premium, and within about 75 minutes the price is back near 29.
presenterNote.zh: 重開 43 分鐘後第一筆鑄造上鏈。發行方把新代幣賣進溢價，約 75 分鐘內價格回到 29 附近。

evidence.label: First mint after Friday: 1,000 HIMS, 00:43:30 UTC

title.en: Aftermath: BONER keeps its gains, the NYSE opens as usual
title.zh: 餘波：BONER 守住漲幅，紐約照常開盤

summary.en: By 09:54 UTC supply has more than doubled to about 33,977 HIMS, the dollar pool is deep again, and BONER sits at about 4x its Friday price.
summary.zh: 到 09:54 UTC，流通量翻倍到約 33,977 顆，美元池的深度恢復，BONER 約是週五價格的 4 倍。

en: At 09:54 UTC the pool quotes about 29.48 and holds about 2,567 HIMS; pushing it 10% costs about 1,307 USDG again. Of the 33,977 HIMS now in existence, about 32,087 sit in Uniswap v4 pools, most of them in BONER's.
BONER does not give its move back: about $0.0147, roughly 4x Friday, an implied $14.7M across 1 billion tokens. HIMS is back near NAV by then, so this gain does not rest on the HIMS premium.

At 13:30 UTC the NYSE opens as usual; in DeFiPrime's telling, the stock itself never noticed. No short seller was forced to buy: what got squeezed was the token's float, not the shares. DeFiPrime leaves open whether this was the system working as designed, the gap closing the moment minting was allowed, or a small-scale trial of what more tokens at stake, stronger memecoin demand and a longer closure could do. A GameStop-paired memecoin had tried the same structure in July.
zh: 09:54 UTC，池子報價約 29.48，握有約 2,567 顆 HIMS；推高 10% 的成本回到約 1,307 USDG。現有的 33,977 顆 HIMS 中約 32,087 顆在 Uniswap v4 池裡，大部分在 BONER 的池子。
BONER 沒有吐回漲幅：約 $0.0147，約週五的 4 倍，以 10 億顆總量計約 1,470 萬美元。此時 HIMS 已回到淨值附近，所以這個漲幅並不是靠 HIMS 的溢價撐起來的。
13:30 UTC 紐約證交所照常開盤；照 DeFiPrime 的說法，股票本身完全沒察覺。也沒有空頭被迫回補：被擠壓的是代幣的流通量，不是股票。DeFiPrime 沒有下定論：這可能是系統照設計運作，一能鑄造價差就被收掉；也可能是一場小規模試演，預示流通量更大、迷因幣買盤更猛、休市更久時會發生什麼。7 月已有一個配對代幣化 GameStop 的迷因幣用過同樣的結構。

presenterNote.en: By Monday morning it is over: supply doubled, the pool is deep again, BONER kept about 4x, and the NYSE opens as usual. Working as designed, or a rehearsal? Still open.
presenterNote.zh: 到週一早上一切結束：流通量翻倍、池子恢復深度、BONER 保住約 4 倍，紐約照常開盤。是系統照設計運作，還是一場預演？目前還沒有答案。

evidence.label: @0xSammy, Mon 07:01 UTC: HIMS pool minting tracker

mechanism.en: The fence closes. From Sat 00:00 to Mon 00:00 UTC, HIMS can be neither minted nor redeemed; the on-chain float is fixed at about 15,227 tokens.
mechanism.zh: 圍欄關上。週六 00:00 到週一 00:00 UTC，HIMS 不能鑄造也不能贖回，鏈上流通量固定在約 15,227 顆。

mechanism.en: Memecoin demand routes through HIMS. BONER's main pool is quoted in HIMS, so buying BONER with dollars means buying HIMS in the dollar pool first.
mechanism.zh: 迷因幣需求繞道 HIMS。BONER 的主池以 HIMS 計價，用美元買 BONER 就得先在美元池買 HIMS。

mechanism.en: HIMS migrates. Each such trade moves HIMS from the HIMS/USDG pool into the BONER/HIMS pool, where no LP withdrew all weekend and HIMS only leaves when someone sells BONER; the dollar pool's HIMS falls from about 2,606 to under 4 in less than four hours (19:40 to 23:25 UTC).
mechanism.zh: HIMS 搬家。每筆這樣的交易都把 HIMS 從 HIMS/USDG 池搬進 BONER/HIMS 池；那個池整個週末沒有 LP 撤資，HIMS 只有在有人賣 BONER 時才會流出。美元池的 HIMS 在不到四小時內（19:40 到 23:25 UTC）從約 2,606 顆降到不到 4 顆。

mechanism.en: The price leaves the LP ranges. Above the concentrated positions there is almost no HIMS to sell; on the rebuilt positions this accounts for about 91% of the dollar pool's lost HIMS, and the cost of pushing the price up 10% drops from about 1,351 to about 12 USDG, and to 3.85 at the low.
mechanism.zh: 價格漲出 LP 區間。集中流動性部位之上幾乎沒有 HIMS 可賣；依重建的部位計算，美元池流失的 HIMS 約 91% 來自這個效應，把價格推高 10% 的成本從約 1,351 降到約 12 USDG，最低時只要 3.85。

mechanism.en: Reopen and mint. The 24/5 session reopens at Mon 00:00 UTC; the first mint lands at 00:43:30, and 294 mints add about 18,750 HIMS by 09:54.
mechanism.zh: 重開與鑄造。24/5 時段在週一 00:00 UTC 重開；第一筆鑄造在 00:43:30 上鏈，到 09:54 共 294 次鑄造、約 18,750 顆 HIMS。

mechanism.en: Collapse. The new HIMS is sold into the pools; the premium drops from about 93% at 00:47 to about 12% at 00:55 and is gone by about 02:00 UTC.
mechanism.zh: 崩塌。新的 HIMS 被賣進池子；溢價從 00:47 的約 93% 掉到 00:55 的約 12%，約 02:00 UTC 前消失。

who.en: The issuer (Robinhood's stock-token issuer and its market-making wallet)
who.zh: 發行方（Robinhood 的股票代幣發行方與其造市錢包）

outcome.en: Once the window reopened it minted new HIMS and its market-making wallet sold them into the pools while the premium lasted. DeFiPrime's reading is that minting at NAV and selling into the premium carried no directional risk and earned the gap. Nothing on-chain shows what, if anything, the issuer anticipated.
outcome.zh: 窗口一重開就鑄造新的 HIMS，由造市錢包在溢價還在時賣進池子。DeFiPrime 的解讀是：按淨值鑄造、賣進溢價沒有方向性風險，賺到的就是價差。鏈上看不出發行方事先是否預期到這件事。

outcome.en: No role in the event. The only link to the real shares runs through the issuer, which is meant to hold one share for each token it mints; how and when it sourced them is not visible on-chain. In DeFiPrime's telling, the stock opened Monday as if nothing had happened.
outcome.zh: 在這件事裡沒有任何角色。和真實股票唯一的連結在發行方：每鑄造一顆代幣，理應持有一股作為擔保；它何時、怎麼取得這些股票，鏈上看不到。照 DeFiPrime 的說法，股票週一開盤時彷彿什麼事都沒發生。

who.zh: HIMS/USDG 池的流動性提供者（LP）

outcome.en: Their positions sold HIMS for USDG as the price rose through their ranges and bought it back as it fell, earning the pool's 0.9% LP fee on the swaps that crossed them. Some withdrew (190 removals against 327 additions), but on the rebuilt positions withdrawals explain only about 9% of the thinning.
outcome.zh: 價格漲過他們的區間時，部位把 HIMS 換成 USDG；價格回落時再買回，從經過區間的交易中賺取池子 0.9% 的 LP 手續費。有人撤資（190 次撤出、327 次加入），但依重建的部位計算，撤資只能解釋約 9% 的變薄。

who.zh: 追高買進 HIMS 的人

outcome.en: Anyone who bought HIMS at 40–60 USDG on Sunday night held a token trading near 29 a couple of hours later. DeFiPrime places the losses here.
outcome.zh: 週日深夜用 40–60 USDG 買進 HIMS 的人，幾個小時後手上的代幣只剩約 29。DeFiPrime 認為損失集中在這群人身上。

who.zh: 沒有鑄造權限的套利者

outcome.en: Over the weekend there was no way for them to close the gap. After the first mint, two cyclic trades made about 2.71 and 5.61 USDG before costs: small change next to the premium.
outcome.zh: 週末期間他們沒有辦法收掉價差。首次鑄造後，兩筆循環交易扣除成本前約賺 2.71 與 5.61 USDG，和溢價相比只是零頭。

outcome.en: Holders from before Sunday night came out ahead on paper: BONER was about 4x its Friday price at 09:54, and since HIMS was back near NAV by then, the gain did not depend on the HIMS premium.
outcome.zh: 週日深夜之前就持有的人帳面上是贏家：09:54 時 BONER 約是週五價格的 4 倍，而那時 HIMS 已回到淨值附近，所以這個漲幅不依賴 HIMS 的溢價。

hakari.en: Any protocol that reads a price from this pool, whether a lending market, an options venue or a perp oracle, would have seen a stock that closed at 28.84 quoted at about 61, and at 71.23 at the highest minute close, and nothing in the number itself says it is 112% to 147% away from the share behind it. What had changed was the cost of moving it: pushing HIMS/USDG up 10% and selling straight back cost about 1,351 USDG at 19:40 and about 12 USDG at 23:53, more than a hundred times cheaper, while the fence meant no arbitrageur could pull the price back. That cost is what HAKARI measures, and the cost-to-push lane on this page follows the same method as HAKARI's PushCostLens. The calendar alone cannot tell such weekends apart: on the ordinary weekend of 2026-09-18 the cheapest moment for HIMS while minting was closed was still about 0.96x its Friday cost, against about 0.009x on 2026-08-30. So HAKARI measures at settlement time and settles on the raw price only when faking it would cost more than faking it would earn.
hakari.zh: 任何從這個池子讀價格的協議，不論是借貸市場、選擇權平台還是永續合約的預言機，都會看到一檔收盤 28.84 的股票被報到約 61，最高的分鐘收盤價更到 71.23，而這個數字本身看不出它離背後的股票已經差了 112% 到 147%。改變的是推動它的成本：把 HIMS/USDG 推高 10% 再立刻賣回，19:40 要約 1,351 USDG，23:53 只要約 12 USDG，便宜了一百倍以上；同時圍欄讓套利者沒辦法把價格拉回來。HAKARI 量的就是這個成本，本頁的推價成本那條線，用的也是和 HAKARI PushCostLens 相同的方法。光看日曆分不出這兩種週末：在 2026-09-18 那個平常的週末，鑄造關閉期間 HIMS 最便宜的時刻仍約是週五成本的 0.96 倍，而 2026-08-30 只剩約 0.009 倍。所以 HAKARI 在結算當下量測，只有在造假的成本高於造假能賺到的錢時，才用原始價格結算。

next.en: Once the Vexi integration is done, a later version of this page will overlay how a HAKARI-guarded Vexi settlement would have read these same minutes: which price it would have settled on, when it would have flagged the pool as fenced, and how far that sits from the raw spot.
next.zh: 等 Vexi 的整合完成後，本頁的下一版會疊上一層：由 HAKARI 把關的 Vexi 結算會怎麼讀這幾分鐘，包括它會用哪個價格結算、什麼時候把這個池子標成圍欄池，以及和原始現價差多少。

def.en: An ERC-20 token meant to track one share of a listed company, created and redeemed by an issuer that holds the underlying shares. HIMS here is Robinhood's token for Hims & Hers.
def.zh: 設計成追蹤一股上市公司股票的 ERC-20 代幣，由持有底層股票的發行方鑄造與贖回。這裡的 HIMS 是 Robinhood 發行、對應 Hims & Hers 的代幣。

def.en: The number of tokens that exist on-chain and can trade. For HIMS it was about 15,227 over the weekend.
def.zh: 鏈上實際存在、可以交易的代幣數量。HIMS 週末期間約 15,227 顆。

def.en: The hours in which the issuer can create new tokens (after buying shares) or destroy them (after selling shares). It follows brokerage hours, so it is closed over the weekend.
def.zh: 發行方可以鑄造新代幣（買進股票後）或銷毀代幣（賣出股票後）的時段。它跟著券商的交易時間走，所以週末是關閉的。

def.en: A trading pool that lives inside Uniswap v4's single PoolManager contract and is identified by an id rather than its own address. Its price moves with every swap.
def.zh: 位在 Uniswap v4 單一 PoolManager 合約裡的交易池，用 id 識別而不是自己的合約地址。每一筆兌換都會移動它的價格。

def.en: LPs provide liquidity only between two prices they choose. Once the price moves above a position's range, that position holds only the quote token (here USDG) and has no HIMS left to sell.
def.zh: LP 只在自己選定的兩個價格之間提供流動性。價格一旦漲過某個部位的區間，這個部位就只剩報價資產（這裡是 USDG），沒有 HIMS 可賣。

def.en: Net asset value: what the token should be worth, one HIMS share. Over the weekend the best reference is Friday's NYSE close, 28.84.
def.zh: 資產淨值，也就是代幣理應值多少：一股 HIMS。週末期間最合理的參考是週五紐約收盤價 28.84。

def.en: How far the token trades above NAV, in percent. 61.15 against 28.84 is a 112% premium.
def.zh: 代幣價格高於淨值的百分比。61.15 相對 28.84 就是 112% 的溢價。

def.en: The chain of pools a trade passes through. Buying BONER with USDG goes USDG → HIMS → BONER, so it buys HIMS on the way.
def.zh: 一筆交易依序經過的池子。用 USDG 買 BONER 的路由是 USDG → HIMS → BONER，途中會先買進 HIMS。

term.zh: 流通量擠壓 vs. 軋空

def.en: A short squeeze forces short sellers to buy back, which drives the price up. Here nobody was short: demand simply ran into a supply of tokens that could not grow until Monday. As @0xSammy put it on 1 September, “It’s a float squeeze not a short squeeze”.
def.zh: 軋空（short squeeze）是空頭被迫回補而推高價格。這次沒有人放空，只是需求撞上一個週一之前無法增加的代幣供給，所以是流通量擠壓（float squeeze）。@0xSammy 在 9 月 1 日也特別澄清：這是流通量擠壓，不是軋空。

def.en: A pool whose price-anchoring arbitrage is shut, here because the mint/redeem window is closed. A push on a fenced pool is not pulled back.
def.zh: 把價格拉回原位的套利管道被關閉的池子，這裡是因為鑄造／贖回窗口關閉。在圍欄池裡把價格推走，不會有人把它拉回來。

def.en: What it costs in fees to move a pool's price by a given percentage and sell straight back. A low cost means the price is cheap to fake.
def.zh: 把池子價格推動某個百分比、再立刻賣回所損失的手續費。成本越低，這個價格越便宜就能造假。

def.en: A dollar stablecoin and the quote asset of the main HIMS pool. Prices on this page are in USDG; we do not assume it is worth exactly $1.
def.zh: 美元穩定幣，也是 HIMS 主池的報價資產。本頁價格都以 USDG 計，不假設它剛好等於 1 美元。

caveats.en: A pool's spot price is not an executable price. It is the marginal price after the last swap; buying any real size would pay more, and 61.15 is a sampled spot, not a trade anyone could repeat at size.
caveats.zh: 池子的現價不是可成交價。它只是上一筆兌換後的邊際價格；任何有規模的買單都會付更多，61.15 是取樣到的現價，不是可以用大額重複成交的價格。

caveats.en: Prices are in USDG and USDG is not assumed to be exactly $1. Dollar figures quoted from DeFiPrime and @0xSammy are pool prices in USDG.
caveats.zh: 價格以 USDG 計，不假設 USDG 剛好等於 1 美元。引用自 DeFiPrime 與 @0xSammy 的美元數字，其實是以 USDG 計的池內價格。

caveats.en: HIMS held by a pool's positions is estimated from rebuilt LP positions (principal) and excludes uncollected fees. It is not an exact reserve and not the depth available at a given size. The PoolManager's total HIMS covers every v4 pool and is a different measure.
caveats.zh: 池子部位持有的 HIMS 是由重建的 LP 部位估算的本金，不含尚未領取的手續費；它不是精確的儲備量，也不是某個交易規模下的可成交深度。PoolManager 持有的 HIMS 總量涵蓋所有 v4 池，是另一種量法。

caveats.en: NAV here is Friday's NYSE close. After Mon 00:00 UTC the stock traded again in Robinhood's overnight session, which this page does not track.
caveats.zh: 這裡的淨值以週五紐約收盤價為準。週一 00:00 UTC 之後股票在 Robinhood 的夜盤重新交易，本頁沒有追蹤那個價格。

caveats.en: This is one ticker on one weekend. NVDA and TSLA dollar pools on the same weekend showed no comparable collapse, and neither did any of the 13 stock pools HAKARI rebuilt for the weekend of 2026-09-18. The timing supports the explanation but is not a causal proof, and nothing here identifies any trader's motive.
caveats.zh: 這只是一檔股票、一個週末。同一週末的 NVDA 與 TSLA 美元池沒有出現類似的崩落，HAKARI 重建的 2026-09-18 週末 13 個股票池也都沒有。時間順序支持這個解釋，但不是因果證明，也無法據此判斷任何交易者的動機。

caveats.en: The ~91% / ~9% split compares two observed states of the pool; it is an accounting attribution, not a causal measurement. Withdrawals can themselves move the price, and the split says nothing about why any LP acted.
caveats.zh: 約 91%／約 9% 的拆分是比較池子兩個觀察時點的會計歸因，不是因果量測。撤資本身也可能推動價格，這個拆分也無法說明任何 LP 為什麼這樣做。

caveats.en: The two cyclic arbitrage gains are gross figures. After gas and any other costs their net result is not proven.
caveats.zh: 兩筆循環套利的獲利是毛額。扣除 gas 與其他成本後是否真的淨賺，目前無法證明。

caveats.en: The charts are re-derived from on-chain logs by this page's own collector, so they can differ slightly from DeFiPrime's or earlier samples taken at other blocks.
caveats.zh: 圖表數據由本頁自己的收集程式從鏈上紀錄重新計算，與 DeFiPrime 或先前在其他區塊取樣的數字可能略有差異。
